summary: Ask your own files a question in plain language instead of guessing the keyword you typed six months ago. Semantic search as an MCP server: sqlite-vec + a multilingual ONNX model, incremental re-indexing, answers returned as file:line. No server, no API key, no network at query time. Grounded LLM Q&A is opt-in. 50 tests.
